name: TMKOC Men Pampering Baby
visual_description: Eight-panel collage of Gokuldham society men (Jethalal, Champaklal, Iyer, Taarak Mehta, Sodhi, Popatlal, Hathi) lovingly holding and cuddling a baby wearing a colorful cap.
usage_context: Used to express universal love, pampering, or undivided affection showered on someone or something by everyone in a group.

example.caption: The youngest cousin when they visit during summer vacation:
